topic: انتحال الشخصية — زاوية جديدة: Checklist عملية قبل بدء أي إجراء
prompt:
PRIMARY VISUAL BRIEF — FOLLOW THIS SCENE EXACTLY: Photorealistic contemporary editorial close-up of an identity verification scene: a neutral unbranded identity card with all lettering deliberately blurred, a clear fingerprint evidence impression on a transparent forensic sheet, and a magnifying glass inspecting the identity photo area. A secure document sleeve and evidence tags sit on a clean desk. The dominant action is checking whether an identity document belongs to the person presenting it. No readable text, no police uniform, no handcuffs, no courthouse, no scales of justice, no logos.
